sources.title: [2509.16952] AirQA: A Comprehensive QA Dataset for AI Research with ...
sources.snippet: In this work, we propose AirQA, a human-annotated comprehensive paper QA dataset in the field of artificial intelligence (AI), with 13,956 papers and 1,246 questions, that encompasses multi-task, multi-modal and instance-level evaluation. Furthermore, we propose ExTrActor, an automated framework for instruction data synthesis.

sources.snippet: We propose AirQA, human-annotated multi-modal multi-task multi-paper QA dataset with function-based instance-specific evaluations. best of knowledge, AirQA is the first dataset that encompasses multiple questiontypes, the bring function-based evalua-tion into QA domain, enabling convenient systematic assessment of research capabilities.
